diagnostic_investigation.dense_model_suitability: The zero-shot dense model was frozen before evaluation; a diagnostic miss is reported rather than tuned away.
diagnostic_investigation.normalization: Document and query embeddings are L2-normalized and tested against cosine equivalence.
diagnostic_investigation.query_document_prefix: The fixed E5 query/document prefixes are asserted by automated tests.
diagnostic_investigation.query_truncation: The fixed maximum input length is recorded; inspect long serialized queries if complementarity targets fail.
diagnostic_investigation.representation_independence: BM25 tokens and dense embeddings use separate implementations; measured Jaccard values quantify overlap.
